modules.title: Security Intelligence And Investigative Practice
modules.summary: Security Intelligence and Investigative Practice focuses on the collection, analysis, and interpretation of information to identify, assess, and mitigate security threats and risks. The field examines investigative techniques, intelligence-gathering methods, and evidence-based decision-making processes used in both public and private sectors. It equips professionals with the skills to conduct effective investigations, manage security challenges, and support strategic risk management. The discipline also emphasizes ethical, legal, and professional standards in intelligence and investigative operations.
